# Servactory

> A service object framework for Ruby on Rails applications. Servactory provides a structured approach to organizing business logic using service objects with typed inputs, outputs, and actions.

A set of tools for building reliable Ruby/Rails services of any complexity

## Table of Contents

- [Actions on the Featury object](https://servactory.com/featury/guide/actions.md): Description and examples of using actions on the Featury object
